answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 149017 Country: India Title: Dog hairs in water sump Question: I am rented in ground floor and in 3rd floor another tenants are staying who has a pet dog. They take the dog for a walk which spreads dogs hairs across stairs and in front of my home. Sometimes even these hairs fall into water sump. Same water we use for ghusl, wudhu and for washing utensils. We have applied filter in our taps to avoid it. But want to know what Islam says in this regard. Answer ID: 149017 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 700/823/H=7/1438) According to Imam Abu Hanifah (may Allah have mercy upon him) a dog is not Najas al-Ain (impure by nature), rather only its saliva is impure. Hence in the question mentioned above if there is no physical impurity on the hair of the dog then merely by falling these hair in the water it will not be impure. You may do ghusl and make wudhu with that water, it is allowable. عن ابى حنيفة رحمة الله فى الكلب اذا وقع فى الماء ثم خرج حياً أنه لا بأس به ، وهذه إشارة إلى أن عين الكلب ليس بنجس ، وقال أيضا فى كلب وقع فى ماء وخرج حياً ، فأعتجنوا منه فلا بأس بذلك هكذا روى ابن المبارك عن ابى حنيفة وفى الجامع الصغير : إذا وقع الكلب فى البئر وخرج حياً ، قال: ابو النصر الدبوسي رحمه الله إن لم يصل فمه إلى الماء ولم يكن على دبره نجاسة لم يتنجس الماء . (المحيط للبرهاني 1/256 ، دارالكتب العلمية بيروت). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
